sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks' row 16 (#15 dockerfile_builds_the_declared_world) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 16 (same text, no annotation/comment); 'Deterministic Checks' rows 9-12, 32, 39 for related mechanical checks
evidence: Static: task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...67d1) is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile (diff empty, same hash), so it is template-controlled and unmodified. Line 1 FROM node:22-bookworm-slim (versioned tag, no --platform); line 3 ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; lines 9-12 npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (exact pins, matching solution/app/package.json dependencies and the skill's ### 15 expectation); apt packages (ca-certificates git procps sqlite3) are unpinned, which the workbook deterministic row check-dockerfiles.py classifies as a NOTE, not a failure. Lines 14-16 COPY instructions/ /instructions/, COPY assets/ /assets/, chmod -R a+rX on both; lines 17-23 create /app, git init, commit only .gitkeep. No COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/. Golden server.js requires only crypto/fs/path/express/better-sqlite3 (lines 7-11); solve.sh only copies files (no npm install), so no run-time install is needed. integration.md line 3 publicly states express and better-sqlite3 are preinstalled via NODE_PATH, consistent with the image. assets/kittle.json hash 42ab8b97... equals solution seed and the path /assets/kittle.json named in instruction.md line 5. Tests/Dockerfile lines 16-22 install the same two pinned packages for the separate verifier. Runtime (this review, 9 Oct 2026): docker build of the frozen environment/ as tag qc-r15-kittle-agent:r1 succeeded (sha256:21717533...a3a); docker run --network none showed /app contains only .git and .gitkeep with one commit 'Initialize task workspace', git ls-files = .gitkeep; /assets/kittle.json and the three /instructions/*.md are world-readable; node v22.23.2; as uid 65534 from /tmp with no network, require('express') and better-sqlite3 :memory: query succeeded; then frozen solve.sh + DB_PATH=/tmp/t.db node /app/server.js started and GET /api/health returned 200, all with network disabled, proving no run-time install is needed. /tests absent in image. Image removed afterwards. Adversarial: a broken app relying on an extra package (e.g. sqlite3 or a local npm install) is not rescued by this row; that is a builder failure surfaced at verification, not a Dockerfile defect. A conforming alternative using node:sqlite or only the preinstalled pair runs fine in this image, so no valid app is blocked by the image.
run_verdict: PASS (local docker build + offline dependency/solve/health run of the frozen agent image; not a hosted QC or judge run)
